trigger: Opened the City Archive Library with the seal
note: Asha on comms reacts to the merge draft. Reuses stills; VO via ElevenLabs.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Dust lifts off the draft. The vote is there in brittle ink — merge, or become dust that remembers nothing.

lines.speaker: ASHA
lines.text: Kaela — your channel just spiked. You opened the Archive.

lines.speaker: ASHA
lines.text: A whisper of a vote. That is not clean courage. That is people scared enough to become code.

lines.speaker: ASHA
lines.text: I deserted Station Seven for a sympathetic AI. This is older. Heavier.

lines.speaker: ASHA
lines.text: Keep the override if you still have it. Believe her if you must — but bring that fear to the Core. Voss only hears weapons. Make him hear a people.

panels.then: title card THE DRAFT SPEAKS over the lower third
